name: cluster-context
description: Tells Claude which Slurm node it is on (GPUs, time left), keeps Hugging Face caches and big downloads on /scratch, and asks before starting a new allocation when this node could do the work.

scratchRoot.title: Scratch root
scratchRoot.description: Where downloads, weights, datasets and caches belong. Leave empty for /scratch/$USER.

minMinutesLeft.title: Minutes left to keep work here
minMinutesLeft.description: On a GPU node with at least this many minutes left, a new srun/sbatch/salloc asks you first.
